name: Every Realizable Ample Class Has a Maximum Parent
statement: Every finite nonempty realizable ample class on $n$ coordinates occurs as a coordinate section of a finite maximum class of rank $n$; an explicit construction uses at most $q+2n$ auxiliary coordinates when $q$ is the number of minimal missing patterns.
proof: Use positive rational strict separators for the minimal missing patterns. Homogenize their rational coefficients into integer multiplicities, encode the signed inequalities by auxiliary threshold coordinates, and extend the resulting sequence to a maximum class. Fixing the auxiliary mark recovers the original class exactly.
